text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I believe I've grasped the
situation.
Essentially, the heart of what
you wish to say is...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Was it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More like not at all... Honestly, I'm having doubts that she understood any of the words I said.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I jest! I jest! You wish to determine
whether or not
Acute's fatigue stems
from her rigorous training,
yes?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And what was the doctor's diagnosis?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we've already stopped by
Tracen
Academy's infirmary for a
checkup.
choice_data_list: What do you mean you don't know...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The exact diagnosis was "idiopathic
fatigue." According to the doctor, she
isn't sick, but anything beyond that can't
be said with any
certainty.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well,
I can't say I'm surprised. If a
medical
doctor doesn't have your
answers...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwip!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then I, Dr. Overlord, will conduct a
thorough
examination! Come, let us run
together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well I'll be! This is a turn of events. Little old me running with Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I'm afraid I don't run very well on
turf, dearie.
There's no way I'll be able
to keep up with you...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then, we shall run upon the dirt. Be it
land, sea,
or sky, the Overlord is master
over all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Young Werther may have such sorrows,
but
Sadler has none. Just do not ask me
to run on the
hard asphalt of Broadway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no clue what she means, but T.M.
Opera O now stands gallantly on the
track. A scrimmage to determine the
cause of Wonder Acute's fatigue
begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang! Patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Oh my! Opera O looks so relaxed, yet...
she's so
fast! How?)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep pace somehow... I have
to!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, an impressive burst of energy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(The dirt is where I excel! All I need is
one last
push!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: NNNGRAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, most magnificent! You're like a
fairy who
has abandoned her pumpkin
carriage to instead
run at full tilt!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I wonder if you haven't forgotten
who it is you
face... It is none other than
the Overlord! Now, for our castle
rendezvous!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her opponent is a holder of seven
crowns. Even having an advantage on
dirt isn't enough to
bridge that kind of
gap.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, wheeze... Phew...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The reason behind your fatigue is plain
as day.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am too mighty an opponent! This is
what
becomes of those who face me
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's what I want to know most of all.
Even
acknowledging that Opera O is on
another level...
choice_data_list: So... any effects from that intens...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's causing Wonder Acute's body to
cry out in
pain? It has to be...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm. After seeing you up close, I, Dr.
Overlord, do
declare...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are the very picture of health!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I am? Well, golly...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The very fact you kept pace
with me despite only being in your
classic year proves
your muscles are still
supple.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'd say those muscles belong to
the upper echelons of dancers the world
over. My very own theater troupe would
welcome you with open arms should you
be so inclined!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean my harsh training
regimen isn't the cause of Wonder
Acute's fatigue? Does that
mean we
have nothing to worry about?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Um, then I guess that means I...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have nothing to fear. Keep up your
training
as usual—nay! Work harder than
ever before!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Overlord guarantees your body is fit
as a
fiddle!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, there you have it, dear. We may
have been
working ourselves up over
nothing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If there's nothing wrong with your
training style, then let's keep doing what
we're doing and get
ready for the Japan
Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both T.M. Opera O and Wonder Acute
try to
reassure me. But still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can I really have complete faith in my
training
style?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just... I don't like how we're doing
something
different every time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I've asked around, and everyone else's
routines
sound way more balanced.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sorry, but could we forget about
the whole
training contract thing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Other Umamusume felt my style was too

dangerous and turned down my scouting
offers...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Wonder Acute is a kind soul who
took on my
methods without a single
complaint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What if that kindness ends up being her downfall? What if my training is the problem? If we keep going forward with it, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll have ruined the career of the only
Umamusume
who ever believed in me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hey? Why the sour face?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!
choice_data_list: I can't make it any harder than this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear! Trainer? Trainer! Waaaaait!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Turning tail right after I
took the
trouble to offer valuable
advice.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why... I'm getting shades of déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, Opera O... I'd like to talk
to you
about the reason why I sometimes
get short of
breath.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I think it might be because—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have a theory, do you? Good for
you. But...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid it matters not to me. Like
stage
directions and prompts, I have no
time for such
things.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, don't you think there is
someone else
you should be telling this
to?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Urk... But...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Never fear, sweet fairy. The clock has
yet to
strike midnight. There is time yet.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Time before the Japan Dirt Derby, that
is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The Japan Dirt Derby...
